title: Basement Feature Wall & Fireplace Ideas | April 2025 GenStone Projects
description: See April 2025 GenStone basement feature wall and fireplace projects. Get ideas for transforming interior spaces with stone panels.

GenStone panels can typically be installed directly over drywall for interior projects as long as the wall structure is sound. Panels are attached to wall studs or other secure mounting points. Brian Cassel Senior Project Coordinator Can I install GenStone panels myself? Yes. GenStone panels are specifically designed for DIY installation. Many homeowners complete projects like accent walls, fireplaces, and garage facades without hiring a contractor. Amanda Lombard Director How realistic do GenStone panels look? GenStone panels are cast from real stone molds to replicate natural textures and shadow lines. Once installed, most people cannot tell the difference between GenStone and traditional masonry. Evan Trevenna Senior Project Coordinator How long does a typical GenStone project take? Most GenStone projects can be completed in a single afternoon or weekend depending on the size of the space. Because the panels are lightweight and designed to interlock, homeowners can install them much faster than traditional masonry stone.
